about.description: {{appName}} keeps your notes, checklists, money and health in one simple place, so you can just write it down and find it again.

features.title: What it does
features.description: Notes that format themselves as you type, checklists you can share with your household, finance books in any currency with charts and category suggestions, and health logs for the whole family, from weight and blood sugar to a child's growth and periods.

private.title: Private by design
private.description: Your items are end-to-end encrypted on your device, so only you and the people you share with can read them; not even we can. Category suggestions are worked out on your device too. Your data is never sold or used for advertising.

everywhere.title: Wherever you are
everywhere.description: It works in any browser on your phone or computer, installs like an app and opens even when you are offline. Choose light or dark, a text size, and English or Bahasa Indonesia.

made.title: Who makes it
made.description: Made by <portfolio>{{author}}</portfolio>. It is free, and its <github>source code</github> is open on GitHub. See what is new in the <changelog>changelog</changelog>.

privacyPolicy.collect: When you create an account, we store your email address and display name. If you sign in with Google, we also store your Google profile photo. We store the notes, tasks, finance books, health logs and settings you create.
privacyPolicy.use: We use this only to run the app: to sign you in, keep your data and let you share it. We don't sell your data or use it for advertising.
privacyPolicy.storage: Everything is stored with Google Firebase (Authentication and Cloud Firestore) and is covered by Google's security and privacy practices.
privacyPolicy.encryption: With end-to-end encryption (on for new accounts, and available to everyone in Settings), the content of your notes, tasks, finance books and health logs is encrypted on your device before it is saved, with keys only you and the people you share with hold. We and Google can't read it. What the app needs to work stays readable: who an item belongs to, who it is shared with, and when it changed. If you lose both your passphrase and your recovery code, nobody can recover your encrypted data.
privacyPolicy.ai: Receipt scanning, quick add and note helpers are optional. Only when you use one is what you chose sent to Google’s Gemini (through Firebase AI Logic): a receipt photo, the text you typed, or the note’s title and text, even for end-to-end encrypted items. Google may keep it and use it to improve its services. We don’t store what is sent; what you add or change is stored like anything else. You agree to this once, before the first use, and can take it back in Settings → Account.
privacyPolicy.sharing: When you share a note, task, book or health log, the people you share it with see its content. Others can find you by your exact email address to share with you; they then see your name and photo. Nobody can browse a list of users.
privacyPolicy.analytics: We use Google Analytics for Firebase to understand how the app is used, for example which pages are opened. It collects usage and device information, never the content of your items.
privacyPolicy.security: To keep out abuse, the app uses Firebase App Check with Google reCAPTCHA, which checks that requests come from this app using signals from your browser.
privacyPolicy.video: The home page has a video hosted on YouTube. It loads only when you press play, from YouTube's privacy-enhanced mode (youtube-nocookie.com); YouTube's own privacy policy then applies to it.
privacyPolicy.contact: To get a copy of your data, or to delete your account and everything in it, email {{email}}.

termsOfService.paragraph2: The service is provided as is, without warranties, and we may suspend accounts for misuse or security issues.

off.title: Turn off end-to-end encryption?

off.fromOthers_other: {{count}} items others encrypted and shared with you will no longer be readable for you, until their owners share them again without encryption.

notice.title: Use Gemini?
notice.send: What you use it on (a receipt photo, text you type or a note) is sent to Google’s Gemini to read or rewrite it. Google may keep it and use it to improve its services, so leave out anything you don’t want to share.
notice.encryption: This happens even for end-to-end encrypted items: that content leaves your device, while what you save is encrypted as usual. Catat Saja doesn’t keep what is sent.
notice.check: Nothing is sent until you use one of these features, and you check the result before anything is added or changed. You can take this back in Settings → Account.
